Die Post Business Solutions liefert Leistungen zur Optimierung, Digitalisierung und Automatisieru... 1 Senior AI Engineer - Post Business Solutions GmbH (w/m/d) Senior AI Engineer - Post Business Solutions GmbH (w/m/d)Standort:  Wien, Wien, AT, 1230

Berufsfeld:  InformationstechnologieWho we are

 

Experience the best of both worlds: Our business unit, Post Business Solutions, operates as a strong B2B Digital Services Provider within the secure corporate environment of Österreichische Post AG. Post Business Solutions is Austria's leading provider of B2B solutions in the areas of digitization, automation, and outsourcing of business processes in information management. We leverage our position of strength, consistently expand our market position, and also expand into neighboring markets. We pursue a clear mission: We aim to elevate the entire usage and management cycle of our customers' information and documents to a completely new level of performance.

 

What we can offer you
 

 * A dynamic and innovative work environment
 * Opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies in AI, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure
 * Professional development and certification support
 * Flexible working hours and hybrid work options
 * A collaborative and inclusive team culture
 * Discounted holiday offers & various shopping benefits
 * Company health promotion & free bank99 employee Account

 

What you will work on

 

 * End-to-End AI Engineering: Design and develop production-grade AI services using C# and .NET, integrating them seamlessly into our B2B document and information service architectures.
 * Intelligent Automation: Implement Azure AI solutions and agentic workflows to automate multi-step business logic for our customers.
 * Architectural Leadership: Shape advanced RAG architectures and LLM orchestration strategies across hybrid (cloud + on-premise) environments.
 * Quality & Performance: Establish evaluation frameworks (e.g., RAGAS, DocVQA) to ensure high-performance model output, security, and scalability.
 * Team Excellence: Guide developers through code reviews and mentorship while collaborating with stakeholders to translate business needs into technical roadmaps.

 

What you bring with you

 

 * Background: 5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally within regulated industries (e.g., finance, public sector, or logistics).
 * AI Expertise: Proven track record in designing RAG architectures and agentic frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, Google Agent Development Kit), including familiarity with agents.md configurations and advanced prompting (e.g., CoT, Few-Shot, ReAct, and Prompt Chaining).
 * The .NET Stack: Expert-level C# and .NET skills, with hands-on experience in Docker, Kubernetes, and the Azure AI ecosystem.
 * Fluency in Python: Ability to work with data science notebooks, and leverage Python-based AI tooling.
 * Modern Protocols: Practical knowledge of standards like MCP and A2A communication patterns.
 * Model Knowledge: Experience deploying Open Source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral, or Gemma).
 * Education & Certs: A technical degree (BSc/MSc) and relevant Microsoft AI certifications (e.g., Azure AI Engineer Associate).
 * Languages: Minimum German B1 level for internal collaboration and fluent English skills. 

 

The minimum salary for a full-time position is EUR 70,000 (gross annual salary all-in). However, we are of course willing to provide overpayment based on prior qualifications and experience!

 * Take responsibility for the complete product lifecycle, from hardware selection and software development through commissioning and customer support at customer sites worldwide
 * Design and implement software components using object-oriented programming principles and C++.
 * Support the acquisition, processing, and utilization of sensor data for industrial applications.
 * Work closely with experts from engineering, data analytics, and process technology to create integrated digital solutions.
 * Contribute to the development of new products and technologies within our Industrial Digitalization portfolio.

 

Technical Expert Activities

 * Solid knowledge of object-oriented programming concepts and practical experience with C++.
 * Practical experience with prototyping, automation, data processing, or related technical applications.
 * Strong interest in combining software development with industrial applications and sensor technologies.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 * Ability and willingness to explain complex technical concepts to customers, operators, and internal stakeholders through documentation, training, and technical discussions.
 * Fluent German and English communication skills, both written and spoken.

 

Nice to have

 * Experience with sensor technologies  with 2D and/or 3D image processing  in industrial automation environments.

jobs.occupation: Senior Product Line Manager - OAM & Network Operations (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
1 Senior Product Line Manager - OAM & Network Operations (m/w/d) Your tasks
 * Define and execute the OAM portfolio strategy and roadmap, aligned with business objectives, customer operational needs, market and technology trends, regulatory requirements, FRMCS evolution, and the GSM-R-to-FRMCS transition.
 * Manage the OAM portfolio across in-house 
 * Capture and translate customer, operational, market, standardization and regulatory requirements into product requirements and priorities and roadmap decisions.
 * Define and evolve OAM capabilities across network and service management, assurance, observability, fault, performance, configuration, inventory, software management and security, driving end-to-end visibility, service health, analytics and root-cause analysis across heterogeneous and multi-vendor environments.
 * Drive automation and intelligent operations across the OAM portfolio, leveraging advanced analytics and AI where relevant to simplify operational processes, diagnostics, troubleshooting and decision support.
 * Drive a consistent and intuitive OAM user experience, ensuring effective visualization of operational information and workflows.
 * Ensure interoperability and integration with customer OSS/NMS/IT environments and multi-vendor ecosystems through appropriate interfaces, APIs and data integration.
 * Drive OAM capabilities supporting GSM-R/FRMCS coexistence and migration, ensuring converged operability across both technologies throughout the transition.
 * Work closely with R&D, system architects and engineering teams to align technical direction and ensure products are designed for operability, maintainability, automation, diagnosability, upgradeability and long-term support.
 * Develop the OAM portfolio value proposition, positioning and support go-to-market activities.
 * Support sales and customer-facing teams through technical workshops, product presentations, proof-of-concepts, and strategic bid activities.
 * Monitor portfolio budget execution, ensuring delivery remains aligned with approved business objectives, priorities and financial targets

Your qualification
 * Degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline Several years of experience in Product Management, System Engineering or Solution Architecture within mission-critical communications.
 * Strong technical understanding of Operations & Maintenance systems for telecommunications or mission-critical communication networks.
 * Solid understanding of network management systems, OSS architectures, service assurance, and operational workflows.
 * Eperience with modern observability platforms and technologies, including metrics, centralized logging, distributed tracing, dashboarding and operational analytics (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, ELK/OpenSearch, or similar).
 * Experience defining operational KPIs, service health indicators and dashboards that enable proactive monitoring and service assurance.
 * Good knowledge of IP networking, virtualization, Linux, cloud-native architectures, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevOps practices.
 * Experience with railway communication systems, preferably GSM-R and/or FRMCS, or equivalent mission-critical communication environments.
 * Familiarity with cybersecurity principles, software lifecycle management, and secure operational practices.
 * Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate operational challenges into product capabilities that improve operability, troubleshooting, automation, and service quality.
 * Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers, operations teams, senior management, and engineering organizations.
 * Fluent English, German and/or French a plus
